biggest_catch: There is a $15 co-op membership fee to join NEC (refundable when service ends); the $50 credit only applies if the referred friend actually joins as a member, and full program rules live in the separate Terms & Conditions and Rules documents.
catches: NEC is a member-owned cooperative: joining costs a $15 membership fee (refundable when service ends), so the referred friend must pay to join before either side earns the credit.
Both sides receive the $50 bill credit only if the referred friend or business joins NEC Co-op Energy; referrals that do not enroll earn nothing.
Full program conditions live in the separate 'Terms & Conditions' and 'View All Rules' documents linked from the referral page — review them before relying on the offer.
The $500/$250 annual referral-leader bonus bill credits are a separate yearly contest announced at the NEC Annual Meeting, not part of the base $50/$50 offer.
Savings framing: the credit reduces a future electricity bill in the NEC Texas service area, not cash income; you must already be an NEC member to earn referrer-side credits.
